author: nickyeow

english.text: We had better go home rather than wait here.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 dang2 laa3，dou1 hai6 faai3 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1。
text: 我哋唔好喺度等喇，都係快啲返屋企啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He keeps his word.

jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dak1 ceot1 zau6 zou6 dak1 dou3。
text: 佢講得出就做得到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That painting is a masterpiece of impressionist art.

jyutping: go2 fuk1 waa6 hai6 jan3 zoeng6 paai3 ge3 daai6 si1 kap1 zok3 ban2。
text: 嗰幅畫係印象派嘅大師級作品。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This pen belongs to me.

jyutping: ni1 zi1 bat1 hai6 ngo5 gaa3。
text: 呢支筆係我㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: When I got home, I was very hungry.

jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 hou2 gwai2 tou5 ngo6。
text: 我返到屋企嗰陣好鬼肚餓。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.

jyutping: hai2 tiu4 gam3 gap1 ge3 gap1 lau4 leoi5 min6 jau4 seoi2，jat1 ding6 wui5 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3。
text: 喺條咁急嘅急流裏面游水，一定會好危險㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I hadn't recognized the importance of this document until you told me about it.

jyutping: nei5 waa6 zo2 bei2 ngo5 teng1 zi1 hau6，ngo5 sin1 zi1 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 jau5 gei2 gam3 gan2 jiu3。
text: 你話咗俾我聽之後，我先知呢份文件有幾咁緊要。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I can read without glasses.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 daai3 ngaan5 geng3 dou1 tai2 dou2 syu1。
text: 我唔戴眼鏡都睇到書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: My mother is still working in the kitchen.

jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zung6 hai2 cyu4 fong2 dou6 zou6 gan2 je5。
text: 我阿媽仲喺廚房度做緊嘢。

author: kaenif

english.text: I am a tourist.
I'm a tourist.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 leoi5 haak3。
text: 我係旅客。

author: tigro1973

english.text: The picture looks better at a distance.

jyutping: fuk1 waa2 jyun5 di1 tai2 hou2 di1。
text: 幅畫遠啲睇好啲。

author: nickyeow

english.text: That's why I told you not to go by yourself.

jyutping: so2 ji5 ngo5 mai6 giu3 nei5 m4 hou2 jat1 go3 jan4 heoi3 lo1。
text: 所以我咪叫你唔好一個人去囉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I like grapes, but I can't eat so many.

jyutping: ngo5 hai6 zung1 ji3 sik6 tai4 zi2，bat1 gwo3 gam3 do1 zau6 zan1 hai6 sik6 m4 lok6。
text: 我係鍾意食提子，不過咁多就真係食唔落。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom was my first boyfriend.

jyutping: aa3 Tom hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5。
text: 阿Tom係我第一個男朋友。

author: cantonesespoken

english.text: I eat cheese.

jyutping: ngo5 sik6 zi1 si2。
text: 我食芝士。

author: richke

english.text: Don't be afraid of making mistakes. Just do it.

jyutping: m4 hou2 geng1 ceot1 co3，nei5 ziu3 zou6 zau6 dak1 laa3。
text: 唔好驚出錯，你照做就得喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He would like to take part in the competition.

jyutping: keoi5 soeng2 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3。
text: 佢想參加比賽。

author: kaenif

english.text: I don't even know where.

jyutping: ngo5 lin4 hai6 bin1 dou6 lai4 dou1 m4 zi1。
text: 我連係邊度嚟都唔知。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He not only speaks French, but he speaks Spanish, too.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 sik1 gong2 faat3 man4，zung6 sik1 gong2 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man4。
text: 佢唔單止識講法文，仲識講西班牙文。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I was in the hospital for a few days.

jyutping: ngo5 jap6 zo2 gei2 jat6 ji1 jyun2。
text: 我入咗幾日醫院。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Today is the warmest day of the year.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 cyun4 nin4 zeoi3 jit6 ge3 jat1 jat6。
text: 今日係全年最熱嘅一日。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Turn around. Now, without looking, guess how many fingers I'm holding up.

jyutping: ning6 zyun2 min6。naa4，m4 zeon2 mong6 aa3 haa2，gu2 haa2 ngo5 geoi2 hei2 zo2 gei2 do1 zek3 sau2 zi2？
text: 擰轉面。嗱，唔准望呀吓，估吓我舉起咗幾多隻手指？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Ignorance is not an indication of stupidity.

jyutping: mou4 zi1 bing6 m4 doi6 biu2 jyu4 ceon2。
text: 無知並唔代表愚蠢。

author: alishalikescats

english.text: Doctor, can I drink beer?

jyutping: ji1 sang1，ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 jam2 be1 zau2 aa3？
text: 醫生，我可唔可以飲啤酒呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: The wound on my leg is healing.

jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 go3 soeng1 maan6 maan6 hou2 gan2。
text: 我隻腳個傷慢慢好緊。

author: Akh2403

english.text: What does the QR code say?

jyutping: ni1 go3 QR gong2 mat1 je5？
text: 呢個QR講乜嘢？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I said I'm tired of it.

jyutping: ngo5 waa6 gau3 pei4 laa3！
text: 我話夠疲喇！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I don't think I can leave early.

jyutping: ngo5 jam6 mou4 dak1 zou2 zau2 laak3。
text: 我恁無得早走嘞。

author: Gearhulk

english.text: I heard that Tom is good at dancing. Is that true?

jyutping: ngo5 teng1 gong2 aa3 tong1 tiu3 mou5 hou2 lek1。hai6 mai6 zan1 gaa3？
text: 我聽講阿湯跳舞好叻。係咪真㗎？

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The crew and Daphnis fell into the sea and came to the surface again but they had not equal chances for preservation. The pirates had their swords at their sides and their bucklers slung behind them, while their greaves reached to the middle of their legs; whereas Daphnis, as usual when he tended his herd in the plains, had not even his sandals on, and, moreover, as the season was very warm, he was scarcely dressed.

jyutping: syun4 jyun4 tung4 daat6 fu1 nei4 si1 dit3 zo2 lok6 hoi2，jin4 hau6 zoi3 lai4 dou3 seoi2 min2，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 mou5 ping4 dang2 ge3 bou2 cyun4 gei1 wui6。di1 hoi2 dou6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gim3 fong3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 bin1，zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 teon5 paai4 gwaa3 hai2 keoi5 dei6 hau6 min6，ji4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wu6 zek3 zau6 san1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 goek3 zung1 gaan1； ji4 daat6 fu1 nei4 si1，zau6 hou2 ci5 ping4 si4 hai2 ping4 jyun4 ziu3 gu3 keoi5 ge3 ngau4 kwan4 go2 zan6，lin4 keoi5 deoi3 loeng4 haai4 dou1 mou5 zoek6，ji4 ce2，jau4 jyu1 gwai3 zit3 hou2 wan1 nyun5，keoi5 gei1 fu4 mou5 zoek3 saam1。
text: 船員同達夫尼斯跌咗落海，然後再嚟到水面，但係佢哋冇平等嘅保存機會。啲海盜將佢哋嘅劍放喺佢哋兩邊，將佢哋嘅盾牌掛喺佢哋後面，而佢哋嘅護脊就伸到佢哋嘅腳中間； 而達夫尼斯，就好似平時喺平原照顧佢嘅牛群嗰陣，連佢對涼鞋都冇着，而且，由於季節好溫暖，佢幾乎冇着衫。
